correctness.rationale: For n=2pq the deficiency is exactly pq-3p-3q-3. Because it is smaller than pq, no three-divisor representation can use pq, leaving exactly twenty triples from {1,2,p,2p,q,2q}. Writing a triple as c+ap+bq gives the exact factorization (p-(b+3))(q-(a+3))=(a+3)(b+3)+c+3. The right side is at most 33 and both factors are positive, so enumerating its positive divisors is exhaustive without any search cutoff. The packaged verifier reconstructs all twenty rows, finds exactly six prime pairs, and directly verifies each divisor-sum identity.
